title: Stepwise cross-region tenant resynchronization and traffic soft-swap
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create and validate an operational runbook and automation for performing a safe, observable, stepwise soft-swap of tenant traffic between regions when KV cache desynchronization or partial regional degradation occurs. This ticket covers: preflight checks, automated KV/metadata resynchronization verification, staged traffic percentage shifting, real-time telemetry gating, rollback triggers, and customer communication templates for Hosted and Dedicated customers. Focus on minimizing error amplification, preserving in-flight requests, and providing clear operator guidance for private deployments where control plane access is limited.
acceptance_criteria: A documented runbook in Confluence with clear preflight and rollback steps
Automation scripts (terraform/ansible/infra-run) for stage-based traffic shift exist in GitHub and pass CI
Canary shift tests in staging simulate KV drift and complete with no >1% client error increase
Playbook templates for customer communications created and reviewed by Support and Sales
Post-swap healthcheck asserts KV consistency and request latency SLOs within 10 minutes
runbook_steps: Preflight: verify control-plane connectivity, rate limits, and quota headroom in target region
KV sanity: run kv-checker against both regions (sampling keys for tenant) and fail if >0.5% mismatch
Warmup: spin up warm standby instances in target region with same model variant and quantization profile
Prefix cache priming: copy hot prefixes or enable prefix-caching relay to reduce cold-token latency
Stage 1 (1%): shift 1% of tenant traffic for 10 minutes, monitor errors and tail latency
Stage 2 (10%): if Stage 1 OK, shift to 10% for 15 minutes and run consistency validator for KV and session state
Stage 3 (50%): if Stage 2 OK, shift to 50% and run throughput/CPU/GPU saturation checks
Final (100%): complete shift if all gates pass; run post-swap reconciliation and schedule background KV resync
Notify: send templated customer update after each stage and final confirmation
rollback_plan: Immediate abort and revert traffic routing to origin region if >3% absolute error increase or sustained latency >2x SLO for 5 minutes
If KV mismatch detected after shift, perform last-known-good snapshot restore to target and replay writes from origin; if not feasible, revert traffic and open a resync incident
Notify customers with ETA and mitigation steps and escalate to on-call infra if rollback triggers
Post-rollback: annotate incident, collect artifacts (traces, kv-snapshots), and schedule hotfix or sync job
metrics_to_monitor: model_inference_errors - track decoding failures and OOMs
preflight_checklist: On-call roster notified and 2 engineers marked as responders
Backup snapshots of tenant metadata taken and stored (s3://redwood-backups/tenants/<tenant>/timestamp)
Circuit breakers and rate limits reviewed for both regions
Customer POC contact and support channel verified
Run kv-checker in dry-run mode and capture baseline
communications: Customer escalation template - initial: We are initiating a controlled region switch to mitigate timeouts; you may see a transient increase in latency for <5 minutes.
Customer escalation template - progress: Stage X completed; no material errors observed; next stage scheduled in Y minutes.
Customer escalation template - completion: Switch complete, normalizing metrics; please report anomalies to support@redwood.ai
